resources.string: App volume, loudness normalization and dynamics
Applies to phone playback. System and DAC volume are independent; cast volume belongs to the receiving device.
Shared volume and gain for all devices
Remember volume and gain per output
USB bit-perfect output bypasses these controls, including mute. Use the DAC’s hardware volume.
Caps the sum of volume, gain and ReplayGain.
At higher gain, enable the limiter under Loudness and dynamics to reduce clipping.
App volume and gain follow the output device. Normal playback uses system media volume keys.

When device memory is enabled, each output saves its own app volume and gain. Volume keys control system media volume during normal playback, including while paused. The selected step applies to the app volume buttons here and foreground keys during processed USB-exclusive output; volume up also unmutes for that USB output. USB bit-perfect output requires DAC hardware volume. Cast keys control the receiving device. Devices without a unique ID share records by type and name; identical USB DAC models share a record.
Volume could not be saved. Adjust it again to retry.
This restores app volume and gain to 0 dB, resets the ceiling and step size, and clears mute. Playback may get louder.
